description: Add remote history of right ankle fracture at age 16
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia and workup for polyuria was done. His past medical history is notable for a right ankle fracture at age 16, which healed without complications. CMP and A1c were normal but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
